title: DNA extraction from resin producing Boswellia tree
author: Adil Khan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.2.1645/v2

steps.title: Prepare leaf tissue for extraction
steps.instruction: Collect fresh young Boswellia leaves showing minimal necrosis; transport on liquid nitrogen or ice packs (4 °C). On ice, chop leaves into ~5 mm pieces, removing major veins, in a 90 × 100 mm glass Petri dish using a sterilized blade (autoclaved 121 °C, 20 min). Rinse/chop with autoclaved distilled water (ADW) chilled at 2 °C, keep the suspension at 4 °C for 3 h, replacing ADW every 1 h in the dark. Dry the chopped material on sterilized filter paper, grind immediately in liquid nitrogen to a fine powder (color change to off‑white), transfer the powder to a 50 mL Falcon tube and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Make a base solution of 100 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 7.5), 25 mM EDTA, and 1.5 M NaCl; autoclave and store at 24 °C. Immediately before use, for each 10 mL of buffer add 2.5 % (w/v) CTAB, 1.5 % (w/v) PVP (or 3.0 % as noted), 0.5 % (w/v) L‑ascorbic acid, 0.5 % (w/v) BSA, and 0.5 % (v/v) β‑mercaptoethanol. Warm the complete buffer to 65 °C in autoclaved bottles and dissolve the additives by gentle intermittent swirling.

steps.title: Lyse tissue with extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Place 1 g of frozen powdered leaf tissue into a new 50 mL Falcon tube, add 10 mL of the pre‑heated extraction buffer, and vortex for 30 s. If the tissue was not previously ground with a mortar and pestle, vortex the tube for 5 min; otherwise proceed to the next step.

steps.title: Incubate and centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 65 °C (incubator or water bath) for 45 min, inverting gently every 10 min. Allow the tube to equilibrate to room temperature for 5 min, then centrifuge at 3000 × g for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Extract with chloroform:isoamyl alcohol
steps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL of the supernatant to a 2 mL Eppendorf tube containing 1 mL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1). Mix by gentle inversions for 10 min, then place the tube on ice for 10 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge and RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 10 min at 5000 × g at 4 °C. Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 2 mL tube, add 5 µL RNase A (10 mg mL⁻¹), and incubate for 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Second chloroform extraction and salt addition
steps.instruction: Add one volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol to the RNase‑treated sample, mix by inversions for 5 min, then centrifuge 10 min at 5000 × g at 4 °C. Transfer the clear supernatant to a new 2 mL tube and add half the volume of 5 M NaCl; mix gently by inversion.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add two volumes of cold 95 % ethanol to the tube, invert gently, and incubate for 45 min at –20 °C (do not exceed this time).

steps.title: Wash, dry, and resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant. Wash the pellet twice with 1 mL 70 % ethanol, centrifuging each wash at 5000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C. Discard the final supernatant, air‑dry the pellet for 10 min, and resuspend in 50 µL TE buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA pH 8.0).

steps.title: Assess DNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Run an aliquot of the extracted DNA on a 0.1 % agarose gel to evaluate integrity, and measure concentration with a Qubit 3 fluorometer.
